title: Choose the Reviews workspace
question: Each option uses the existing ASC Studio visual system and the same truthful review-response workflow. Choose the structure that should organize the work.

options.label: Response Status Board
options.thesis: Two factual queues expose what needs an answer without turning ratings into a scorecard.
options.viewport: The 121px topbar leads into filters, side-by-side Needs response and Responded queues, and a selected-review response panel.
options.risk: The board makes response state immediate but weakens chronology as review volume grows.

options.label: Review Inbox + Inspector
options.thesis: One chronological inbox turns scanning, selection, and response review into a continuous workflow.
options.viewport: A filter toolbar sits above compact review rows while a 400px inspector shows the full review, Apple response state, and composer.
options.risk: The inspector must become an overlay at medium widths so the inbox never collapses.

options.label: Rating Bands
options.thesis: Five rating bands let operators enter the exact rating range they want to triage.
options.viewport: The topbar and filters lead into five rating lanes with unanswered counts, with selection opening a response sheet at right.
options.risk: Rating becomes the dominant organizing idea and can obscure the content and chronology of reviews.
